_note: Player abilities that slow an ENEMY's ability recast, which is the one
thing a raider can do that moves a mob's AoE timer out from under the
countdown watching it. Reference data about the GAME, like zone_eras.json
and act_spell_timers.json — never about anybody's raid.
`duration_s` is the load-bearing number: it is what turns a damage line
into a WINDOW, and the window is what says whether the cast that started a
recast was made under the debuff. Both numbers come off the ability's own
wiki infobox (gamewiki captures them; wiki_abilities.duration_s / recast_s)
so they can be re-checked rather than remembered.
How MUCH it stretches a given AoE is deliberately NOT here. The tooltip
says -50% reuse speed; measured against clean cycles of the same ability in
the same fight it comes out near x1.31, and Whirling Bladestorm does not
move at all. So the magnitude is LEARNED per (mob, ability) from cycles we
actually watched — see pipeline/aoelearn.py — and this file only says which
abilities open a window and how long it stays open.

Traumatic Swipe.note: duration == recast, so ONE rogue holds it at 100% uptime and two make it permanent. That is why a fight where anybody is pressing it usually has no clean cycle left to compare against.
